title_en: A Theoretical Framework for Statistical Evaluability of Generative Models
title_zh: 生成模型统计可评估性的理论框架

sentences.en: Statistical evaluation aims to estimate the generalization performance of a model using held-out i.i.d. test data sampled from the ground-truth distribution.
sentences.zh: 统计评估旨在利用从真实分布采样的留出独立同分布测试数据，来估计模型的泛化性能。

sentences.en: In supervised learning settings such as classification, performance metrics such as error rate are well-defined, and test error reliably approximates population error given sufficiently large datasets.
sentences.zh: 在诸如分类等监督学习设置中，错误率等性能度量是定义良好的，在数据集足够大时，测试误差能够可靠地近似群体误差。

sentences.en: In contrast, evaluation is more challenging for generative models due to their open-ended nature: it is unclear which metrics are appropriate and whether such metrics can be reliably evaluated from finite samples.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，由于生成模型的开放性本质，其评估更具挑战性：哪种度量是合适的、以及这些度量能否从有限样本中可靠评估，都是不清楚的。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce a theoretical framework for evaluating language models and establish evaluability results for commonly used metrics.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入一个用于评估语言模型的理论框架，并为常用度量建立了可评估性结果。

sentences.en: We study two categories of metrics: test-based metrics, including integral probability metrics (IPMs), and similarity-based metrics, including Rényi and KL divergences.
sentences.zh: 我们研究两类度量：基于测试的度量，包括积分概率度量（IPM）；以及基于相似度的度量，包括 Rényi 和 KL 散度。

sentences.en: We show that IPMs with respect to any bounded test class can be evaluated from finite samples up to multiplicative and additive approximation errors.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，相对于任意有界测试类，IPM 可以从有限样本评估，误差为乘性和加性近似误差。

sentences.en: Moreover, when the test class has finite fat-shattering dimension, IPMs can be evaluated with arbitrary precision.
sentences.zh: 此外，当测试类具有有限的 fat-shattering 维度时，IPM 可以任意精度评估。

sentences.en: In contrast, similarity-based metrics, including Rényi and KL divergences, are not evaluable from finite samples, as their values can be critically determined by rare events.
sentences.zh: 与此相对，基于相似度的度量（包括 Rényi 和 KL 散度）无法从有限样本评估，因为它们的值可能由稀有事件关键性地决定。

sentences.en: We also analyze the potential and limitations of perplexity as an evaluation method.
sentences.zh: 我们还分析了困惑度（perplexity）作为一种评估方法的潜力与局限。

title_en: A Theory of  Contrastive Learning with Natural Images
title_zh: 自然图像对比学习的理论

sentences.en: Why does contrastive learning with simple images and augmentations yield useful representations for downstream tasks?
sentences.zh: 为什么使用简单图像和增广的对比学习能够为下游任务产生有用的表征？

sentences.en: We address this question by analytically computing the optimal representation in terms of a contrastive loss for a range of basic augmentations and any image dataset with stationary statistics.
sentences.zh: 我们通过针对一系列基础增广以及任何具有平稳统计特性的图像数据集，解析地计算对比损失意义下的最优表征，来回答这一问题。

sentences.en: We show  that for certain augmentations the optimum can be attained by a CNN whose first layer filters are sinusoids, followed by a pointwise nonlinearity, global average pooling, and a final linear layer that performs partial whitening.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，对于某些增广，最优值可以由一个 CNN 达到，其第一层滤波器是正弦函数，随后是逐点非线性、全局平均池化，以及一个执行部分白化的最终线性层。

sentences.en: We also show that the optimal weights in such CNNs for more complicated augmentations are still sinusoids.
sentences.zh: 我们还表明，对于更复杂的增广，这类 CNN 中的最优权重仍然是正弦函数。

sentences.en: The frequencies of the sinusoids and their weights can be computed using a simple “waterfilling” algorithm given the dataset’s expected power spectrum.
sentences.zh: 给定数据集的期望功率谱，可以使用一个简单的“注水”（waterfilling）算法计算正弦函数的频率及其权重。

sentences.en: Experiments with different image datasets and augmentations show that such CNNs trained with SGD empirically learn sinusoids in their first layer and to perform partial whitening.
sentences.zh: 针对不同图像数据集和增广的实验表明，这类用 SGD 训练的 CNN 在经验上确实会在第一层学习到正弦函数，并执行部分白化。

title_en: A Theory of Data Acquisition and Pricing at Scale
title_zh: 大规模数据获取与定价理论

sentences.en: Data plays an invaluable role in large-scale ML training pipelines.
sentences.zh: 数据在大规模机器学习训练流程中发挥着无可估量的作用。

sentences.en: Multiple factors, including the need to incentivize the creation of high-quality data and efforts to compensate creative data work, have led to increased interest in data pricing.
sentences.zh: 多重因素——包括激励高质量数据创作的需要，以及为创造性数据工作提供补偿的努力——导致人们对数据定价的兴趣日益增长。

sentences.en: Data pricing mechanisms seek to establish a market where data providers are compensated based (in part) on the value of their data to the data buyer, e.g., frontier AI labs.
sentences.zh: 数据定价机制旨在建立一个市场，其中数据提供者（部分依据其数据对数据买方（例如前沿 AI 实验室）的价值）获得补偿。

sentences.en: However, assessing the exact value that each provider's data adds to the data buyer's objective requires repeated re-training, which is infeasible in practice.
sentences.zh: 然而，评估每个提供者的数据为数据买方目标所增加的精确价值，需要反复重新训练，这在实践中是不可行的。

sentences.en: Our work studies data pricing under compute constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作研究计算约束下的数据定价。

sentences.en: In our setting, data buyers cannot make data acquisition decisions optimally due to limited compute.
sentences.zh: 在我们的设定中，由于计算资源有限，数据买方无法做出最优的数据获取决策。

sentences.en: Inspired by existing practice in the field of data selection, we propose a model for this problem called ``pricing with an attribution oracle,'' and provide a theoretical analysis of compute-efficient acquisition and pricing.
sentences.zh: 受数据选择领域现有实践的启发，我们为这一问题提出了一个称为“带归因预言机（attribution oracle）的定价”的模型，并对计算高效的数据获取与定价进行了理论分析。

title_en: A Theory of How Pretraining Shapes Inductive Bias in Fine-Tuning
title_zh: 预训练如何塑造微调中的归纳偏置：理论分析

sentences.en: Pretraining and fine-tuning are central stages in modern machine learning systems.
sentences.zh: 预训练和微调是现代机器学习系统的核心阶段。

sentences.en: In practice, feature learning plays an important role across both stages: deep neural networks learn a broad range of useful features during pretraining and further refine those features during fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，特征学习在两个阶段都发挥着重要作用：深度神经网络在预训练期间学习广泛的有用特征，并在微调期间进一步优化这些特征。

sentences.en: However, an end-to-end theoretical understanding of how choices of initialization impact the ability to reuse and refine features during fine-tuning has remained elusive.
sentences.zh: 然而，关于初始化选择如何影响微调期间特征重用与优化的能力，目前仍缺乏端到端的理论理解。

sentences.en: Here we develop an analytical theory of the pretraining–fine-tuning pipeline in diagonal linear networks, deriving exact expressions for the generalization error as a function of initialization parameters and task statistics.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们为对角线性网络中的预训练-微调流程发展了一套解析理论，推导出泛化误差作为初始化参数和任务统计量的函数的精确表达式。

sentences.en: We find that different initialization choices place the network into four distinct fine-tuning regimes that are distinguished by their ability to support feature learning and reuse—and therefore by the task statistics for which they are beneficial.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，不同的初始化选择会将网络置于四个不同的微调机制中，这些机制以其支持特征学习和重用的能力加以区分——因此也以它们所适配的任务统计量加以区分。

sentences.en: In particular, a smaller initialization scale in earlier layers enables the network to both reuse and refine its features, leading to superior generalization on fine-tuning tasks that rely on a subset of pretraining features.
sentences.zh: 特别地，更浅层较小的初始化尺度使网络能够同时重用和优化其特征，从而在依赖预训练特征子集的微调任务上获得优越的泛化性能。

sentences.en: We demonstrate empirically that the same initialization parameters impact generalization in ResNets trained on CIFAR-100 and SVHN as well as Transformers trained on modular arithmetic tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们在实证上表明，相同的初始化参数会影响在 CIFAR-100 和 SVHN 上训练的 ResNet 以及在模运算任务上训练的 Transformer 的泛化。

sentences.en: Overall, our results demonstrate analytically how data and network initialization interact to shape fine-tuning generalization, highlighting an important role for the relative scale of initialization across different layers in enabling continued feature learning during fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果从解析上展示了数据和网络初始化如何相互作用以塑造微调泛化，凸显了各层初始化相对尺度在微调期间支持持续特征学习方面的重要作用。

title_en: A theory of learning data statistics in diffusion models, from easy to hard
title_zh: 扩散模型由易到难学习数据统计特性的理论

sentences.en: While diffusion models have emerged as a powerful class of generative models, their learning dynamics remain poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 虽然扩散模型已成为一类强大的生成模型，但其学习动力学仍缺乏深入理解。

sentences.en: We address this issue first by empirically showing that standard diffusion models trained on natural images exhibit a simplicity bias, learning simple, pair-wise input statistics before specializing to higher-order correlations.
sentences.zh: 我们首先通过实证表明，在自然图像上训练的标准扩散模型表现出简单性偏差，先学习简单的成对输入统计量，然后才特化到更高阶的相关性，以此来解决这一问题。

sentences.en: We reproduce this behaviour in simple denoisers trained on a minimal data model, the mixed cumulant model, where we precisely control both pair-wise and higher-order correlations of the inputs.
sentences.zh: 我们在一个最小数据模型——混合累积量模型——上训练简单的去噪器来重现这一行为，在该模型中我们可以精确控制输入的成对和高阶相关性。

sentences.en: We identify a scalar invariant of the model that governs the sample complexity of learning pair-wise and higher-order correlations that we call the _diffusion information exponent_, in analogy to related invariants in different learning paradigms.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出该模型的一个标量不变量，它支配着学习成对和高阶相关性的样本复杂度，我们称之为扩散信息指数（diffusion information exponent），这是类比不同学习范式中的相关不变量而命名的。

sentences.en: Using this invariant, we prove that the denoiser learns simple, pair-wise statistics of the inputs at linear sample complexity, while more complex higher-order statistics, such as the fourth cumulant, require at least cubic sample complexity.
sentences.zh: 利用这一不变量，我们证明去噪器以线性样本复杂度学习输入的简单成对统计量，而更复杂的高阶统计量（如四阶累积量）至少需要三次方的样本复杂度。

sentences.en: We also prove that the sample complexity of learning the fourth cumulant is linear if pair-wise and higher-order statistics share a correlated latent structure.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明，如果成对和高阶统计量共享一种相关的潜在结构，那么学习四阶累积量的样本复杂度是线性的。

sentences.en: Our work describes a key mechanism for how diffusion models can learn distributions of increasing complexity.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作描述了扩散模型如何学习日益复杂分布的一个关键机制。

title_en: A Tight Theory of Error Feedback Algorithms in Distributed Optimization
title_zh: 分布式优化中误差反馈算法的紧致理论

sentences.en: Communication costs are a major bottleneck in distributed learning and first-order optimization.
sentences.zh: 通信成本是分布式学习和一阶优化的一个主要瓶颈。

sentences.en: A common approach to alleviate this issue is to compress the gradient information exchanged between agents.
sentences.zh: 缓解这一问题的一种常见方法是压缩在智能体之间交换的梯度信息。

sentences.en: However, such compression typically degrades the convergence guarantees of gradient-based methods.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种压缩通常会降低基于梯度的方法的收敛保证。

sentences.en: Error feedback mechanisms provide a simple and computationally cheap remedy for this issue, but numerous variants have been proposed, and their relative performance remains poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 误差反馈机制为这一问题提供了一种简单且计算廉价的补救措施，但已经提出了众多变体，它们之间的相对性能仍缺乏清晰理解。

sentences.en: This paper provides tight convergence analyses for two of the main error-feedback algorithms from the literature, the classic Error Feedback method (EF) and Error Feedback 21 (EF21), by identifying optimal step-size choices and constructing optimal Lyapunov functions tailored to each method.
sentences.zh: 本文通过为两种主要的误差反馈算法——经典的误差反馈方法（EF）和误差反馈 21（EF21）——确定最优步长选择并构建针对每种方法量身定制的最优李亚普诺夫函数，为它们提供了紧的收敛性分析。

sentences.en: The results hold independently of the number of agents and recover the known best guarantees possible in the single-agent regime.
sentences.zh: 这些结果与智能体数量无关，并恢复了单智能体机制下已知的最佳可能保证。

title_en: A Time-Reparameterized Cumulative Intensity Extrapolation Sampler for Discrete Flow Matching
title_zh: 用于离散流匹配的时间重参数化累积强度外推采样器

sentences.en: Discrete flow matching (DFM) provides a principled framework for generative modeling on discrete state spaces via continuous-time Markov chain dynamics.
sentences.zh: 离散流匹配（DFM）通过连续时间马尔可夫链动力学，为离散状态空间上的生成建模提供了一个有原则的框架。

sentences.en: In practice, sampling for DFM commonly employs discretizations such as $\tau$-leaping, yet efficient sampling methods under a limited number of function evaluations (NFE) remain less studied.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，DFM 的采样通常采用 $\tau$-leaping 等离散化方法，但在有限函数评估次数（NFE）下的高效采样方法仍然研究较少。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we propose the Time-Reparameterized Cumulative Intensity Extrapolation (TR-CIE) sampler, which aims to improve sampling quality when function evaluations are restricted.
sentences.zh: 为了填补这一空白，我们提出时间重参数化累积强度外推（TR-CIE）采样器，旨在改善函数评估受限时的采样质量。

sentences.en: TR-CIE consists of two components.
sentences.zh: TR-CIE 由两个组件构成。

sentences.en: First, a schedule-based time reparameterization rescales the time grid according to the noise schedule.
sentences.zh: 首先，基于调度的时间重参数化根据噪声调度重新缩放时间网格。

sentences.en: Under standard factorized DFM rate parameterizations, this transformation of variables absorbs the schedule-dependent growth term and mitigates stiffness near the terminal sampling stage.
sentences.zh: 在标准因子化 DFM 速率参数化下，这种变量变换吸收了随调度变化的增长项，并缓解了终止采样阶段附近的刚度问题。

sentences.en: Second, we introduce a cumulative-intensity extrapolation updating rule.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们引入一个累积强度外推更新规则。

sentences.en: By reusing cached model outputs from the previous step as a history term, this improves the approximation of stepwise cumulative intensities on the resulting non-uniform time grid.
sentences.zh: 通过将上一步缓存的模型输出作为历史项复用，它改善了在所得非均匀时间网格上逐步累积强度的近似。

sentences.en: We provide a theoretical analysis that bounds the local approximation error of cumulative intensities and establishes convergence results.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了理论分析，界定了累积强度的局部近似误差，并建立了收敛结果。

sentences.en: The resulting sampler requires one NFE per step and introduces no additional model evaluations compared to the standard $\tau$-leaping sampler.
sentences.zh: 由此产生的采样器每步需要一次 NFE，并且与标准 $\tau$-leaping 采样器相比，不引入额外的模型评估。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on synthetic tasks, text generation, and text-to-image benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves sampling quality under limited NFE.
sentences.zh: 在合成任务、文本生成和文生图基准上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在有限 NFE 下改善了采样质量。

title_en: A Two-Layer Framework for Joint Online Configuration Selection and Admission Control
title_zh: 联合在线配置选择与准入控制的双层框架

sentences.en: We study online configuration selection with admission control problem, which arises in LLM serving, GPU scheduling, and revenue management.
sentences.zh: 我们研究带有准入控制的在线配置选择问题，该问题出现在 LLM 服务、GPU 调度和收益管理等场景中。

sentences.en: In a planning horizon with $T$ periods, we consider a two-layer framework for the decisions made within each time period.
sentences.zh: 在一个包含 $T$ 个周期的规划时域内，我们考虑每个时间周期内所作决策的两层框架。

sentences.en: In the first layer, the decision maker selects one of the $K$ configurations (ex. quantization, parallelism, fare class) which induces distribution over the reward-resource pair of the incoming request.
sentences.zh: 在第一层，决策者从 $K$ 种配置中选择一种（例如量化、并行度、票价等级），这会在到来的请求的奖励-资源对之上诱导一个分布。

sentences.en: In the second layer, the decision maker observes the request and then decides whether to accept it or not.
sentences.zh: 在第二层，决策者观察请求，然后决定是否接受它。

sentences.en: Benchmarking this framework requires care.
sentences.zh: 对该框架进行基准测评需要谨慎。

sentences.en: We introduce a **switching-aware fluid oracle** that accounts for the value of mixing configurations over time, provably upper-bounding any online policy.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个**感知切换的流预言机**（switching-aware fluid oracle），它考虑了随时间混合配置的价值，并可证明地为任何在线策略提供上界。

sentences.en: We derive a max-min formulation for evaluating the benchmark, and we characterize saddle points of the max-min problem via primal-dual optimality conditions linking equilibrium, feasibility, and complementarity.
sentences.zh: 我们推导出一个用于评估该基准的最大-最小形式，并通过将均衡、可行性和互补性联系起来的原始-对偶最优性条件，刻画这一最大-最小问题的鞍点。

sentences.en: This guides the design of **SP-UCB–OLP** algorithm, which solves an optimistic saddle point problem and achieves $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{KT})$ regret.
sentences.zh: 这指导了 **SP-UCB-OLP** 算法的设计，该算法求解一个乐观鞍点问题，并实现 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{KT})$ 的遗憾。

title_en: A Two-Tier Perspective on Inference-Time Parallelism in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
title_zh: 从双层视角理解多智能体大语言模型系统的推理时并行性

sentences.en: Large language model (LLM)-driven multi-agent systems typically require multiple model invocations and complex coordination during inference, and their execution strategies directly affect system accuracy, latency, and computational cost.
sentences.zh: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的多智能体系统在推断期间通常需要多次模型调用和复杂的协调，其执行策略直接影响系统的准确性、延迟和计算成本。

sentences.en: Parallel execution provides a means to improve inference-time efficiency.
sentences.zh: 并行执行为提升推断时效率提供了一种手段。

sentences.en: From the perspective of inference-time execution, this paper models parallelism in multi-agent systems as two distinct levels of decision processes: Replica Parallelism, which explores multiple complete solution paths at the task level, and Structural Parallelism, which enables concurrent execution within a single solution path through task decomposition.
sentences.zh: 从推断时执行的视角出发，本文将多智能体系统中的并行建模为两个不同层级的决策过程：副本并行（Replica Parallelism），即在任务级探索多条完整解路径；以及结构并行（Structural Parallelism），即通过任务分解在单条解路径内实现并发执行。

sentences.en: However, the roles of different forms of parallelism and their interrelationships still lack systematic study in terms of unified organization and coordination.
sentences.zh: 然而，不同形式并行的作用及其相互关系，在统一组织和协调方面仍缺乏系统性研究。

sentences.en: We therefore propose TIPEX, a controllable execution framework that unifies these two levels of parallelism and coordinates their roles within the inference process under a unified execution semantics while supporting systematic combinations and analyses of different parallel strategies and parameter configurations.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出 TIPEX，一个可控的执行框架，它在统一的执行语义下统一这两个层级的并行，并在推断过程中协调它们的作用，同时支持对不同并行策略和参数配置进行系统性组合与分析。

sentences.en: Systematic experiments on the GAIA benchmark demonstrate that inference-time parallelism can significantly improve accuracy and reduce end-to-end latency at the cost of increased token consumption.
sentences.zh: 在 GAIA 基准上的系统性实验表明，推断时并行能够显著提高准确性并降低端到端延迟，但其代价是增加 token 消耗。

sentences.en: Further analysis shows that Replica and Structural Parallelism exhibit complementary effects across task complexities, with tasks of intermediate difficulty benefiting most from their coordination, while overly aggressive parallel strategies do not necessarily yield better performance.
sentences.zh: 进一步分析表明，副本并行和结构并行在不同任务复杂度上表现出互补效应，中等难度任务从其协调中获益最大，而过于激进的并行策略并不一定会带来更好的性能。

title_en: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models via Interactions
title_zh: 通过交互作用统一解释大语言模型知识蒸馏

sentences.en: Despite the success of knowledge distillation (KD) in Large Language Models (LLMs), the underlying mechanism behind its efficacy remains unclear.
sentences.zh: 尽管知识蒸馏（KD）在大语言模型（LLM）中取得了成功，但其有效性背后的底层机制仍不清楚。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a unified approach to explore the common mechanism of various KD methods using interactions.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一种统一方法，利用交互来探索各种 KD 方法的共同机制。

sentences.en: Specifically, we decompose the output score of the LLM into the sum of numerous interactions.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们将 LLM 的输出分数分解为众多交互之和。

sentences.en: Each interaction represents a nonlinear relationship involving a set of input variables (e.g., words).
sentences.zh: 每个交互表示涉及一组输入变量（例如词汇）的非线性关系。

sentences.en: Based on the decomposed interactions, we discover that the common mechanism underlying various KD methods is the sparsification of interactions, i.e., student models retain fewer interactions for inference while suppressing other interactions to zero effects.
sentences.zh: 基于分解后的交互，我们发现各种 KD 方法背后的共同机制是交互的稀疏化，即学生模型为推断保留更少的交互，同时将其他交互抑制为零效应。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we discover that the performance variance across different KD methods arises from their capabilities in handling complex interactions.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们发现不同 KD 方法之间的性能差异源于它们处理复杂交互的能力。

sentences.en: A KD method typically yields better performance if it enables the student model to achieve higher sparsity of complex interactions.
sentences.zh: 如果一种 KD 方法能使得学生模型对复杂交互实现更高的稀疏度，它通常会带来更好的性能。

sentences.en: Motivated by these insights, we propose a plug-and-play loss function called Complex Interaction Penalty (CIP) to explicitly enforce the sparsity of complex interactions during the distillation process.
sentences.zh: 受这些洞见启发，我们提出一个即插即用损失函数，称为复杂交互惩罚（CIP），在蒸馏过程中显式地强制复杂交互的稀疏化。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that integrating CIP consistently improves the performance of diverse KD methods on both in-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，集成 CIP 能够在领域内和分布外基准上一致地提升多种 KD 方法的性能。

title_en: A Unified Density Operator View of Flow Control and Merging
title_zh: 流控制与合并的统一密度算子视角

sentences.en: Recent progress in large-scale flow and diffusion models raised two fundamental algorithmic challenges: $(i)$ control-based reward adaptation of pre-trained flows, and $(ii)$ integration of multiple models, i.e., flow merging.
sentences.zh: 大规模流模型和扩散模型的最新进展提出了两个基本的算法挑战：（i）预训练流的基于控制的奖励适配，以及（ii）多个模型的集成，即流合并（flow merging）。

sentences.en: While current approaches address them separately, we introduce a unifying probability-space framework that subsumes both as limit cases, and enables *reward-guided flow merging*, allowing principled, task-aware combination of multiple pre-trained flows (e.g., merging priors while maximizing drug-discovery utilities).
sentences.zh: 当前方法分别处理这两个问题，而我们引入一个统一概率空间框架，将两者都作为极限情形囊括其中，并实现*奖励引导的流合并*，从而能够有原则地、任务感知地组合多个预训练流（例如，在最大化药物发现效用的同时合并先验）。

sentences.en: Our formulation renders possible to express a rich family of *operators over generative models densities*, including intersection (e.g., to enforce safety), union (e.g., to compose diverse models), interpolation (e.g., for discovery), their reward-guided counterparts, as well as complex logical expressions via *generative circuits*.
sentences.zh: 我们的形式化使得能够表达一族丰富的*作用于生成模型密度之上的算子*，包括交集（例如用于强制安全）、并集（例如用于组合多样模型）、插值（例如用于发现）、它们对应的奖励引导版本，以及通过*生成电路*表达的复杂逻辑表达式。

sentences.en: Next, we introduce Reward-Guided Flow Merging (RFM), a mirror-descent scheme that reduces reward-guided flow merging to a sequence of standard fine-tuning problems.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们引入奖励引导流合并（RFM），一种镜像下降方案，它将奖励引导流合并归约为一系列标准微调问题。

sentences.en: Then, we provide first-of-their-kind theoretical guarantees for reward-guided and *pure* flow merging via RFM.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们为通过 RFM 进行的奖励引导和*纯*流合并提供了同类首创的理论保证。

sentences.en: Ultimately, we showcase the capabilities of the proposed method on illustrative settings providing visually interpretable insights, and apply our method to high-dimensional de-novo molecular design and low-energy conformer generation.
sentences.zh: 最终，我们在说明性设置中展示了所提出方法的能力，提供了视觉上可解释的洞见，并将我们的方法应用于高维从头分子设计和低能构象生成。

title_en: A Unified Framework for Deep Hypergraph Clustering Beyond Homophily
title_zh: 超越同质性的深度超图聚类统一框架

sentences.en: Deep hypergraph clustering exhibits compelling capacity for node representation learning via modeling high-order relationships.
sentences.zh: 深度超图聚类通过建模高阶关系，在节点表征学习方面展现出强大的能力。

sentences.en: However, most existing methods adopt fixed propagation mechanisms and implicitly assume homophily, which presumes that adjacent nodes possess similar characteristics.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有方法采用固定的传播机制，并隐式地假设同配性（homophily），即假设相邻节点具有相似的特征。

sentences.en: This assumption might deviate from real-world situations, particularly under heterophilic conditions, thereby degrading clustering performance.
sentences.zh: 这一假设可能与真实世界的情形有所偏离，特别是在异配（heterophilic）条件下，从而降低聚类性能。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose a \textbf{Uni}fied Framework for \textbf{D}eep \textbf{H}ypergraph \textbf{C}lustering (Uni-DHC).
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一局限，我们提出深度超图聚类统一框架（Uni-DHC）。

sentences.en: Specifically, we design a learnable high-order hypergraph propagation strategy that fuses multi-order information and adaptively learns their importance derived from raw data.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们设计了一种可学习的高阶超图传播策略，它融合多阶信息，并自适应地学习源自原始数据的各阶信息的重要性。

sentences.en: To stabilize unsupervised training and eliminate structural redundancy caused by high-order aggregation, we additionally enforce node-level consistency and hyperedge-level decorrelation constraints.
sentences.zh: 为了稳定无监督训练并消除高阶聚合引起的结构冗余，我们还施加了节点级一致性和超边级去相关约束。

sentences.en: From the spectral perspective, we demonstrate that conventional HGNN-style propagation corresponds to a fixed low-pass filter, whereas our designed method induces a learnable polynomial spectral filter.
sentences.zh: 从谱的视角，我们证明传统的 HGNN 式传播对应于一个固定的低通滤波器，而我们设计的方法则引入了一个可学习的多项式谱滤波器。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on homophilic and heterophilic datasets illustrate that Uni-DHC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving prominent performance improvement in heterophilic settings.
sentences.zh: 在同配和异配数据集上的大量实验表明，Uni-DHC 一致地优于最先进的方法，在异配设置中取得了显著的性能提升。

title_en: A Unified Framework for Diffusion Model Unlearning with f-Divergence
title_zh: 利用 f-散度实现扩散模型遗忘学习的统一框架

sentences.en: Most existing methods for concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models minimize a mean squared error (MSE) loss between the denoiser outputs conditioned on a target and an anchor concept, which is implicitly the KL divergence between two Gaussians.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有的文生图扩散模型概念遗忘方法，会最小化以目标概念和锚定概念为条件的去噪器输出之间的均方误差（MSE）损失，这隐式地就是两个高斯分布之间的 KL 散度。

sentences.en: We generalize this objective to any $f$-divergence, recovering MSE as the KL instance, and identify a family of $\alpha$-divergences whose Gaussian closed-form yields cheap, MSE-like training objectives.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一目标推广到任意 $f$-散度（其中 MSE 作为 KL 的特例被恢复），并识别出一族 $\alpha$-散度，其高斯闭式形式能够产生廉价、类 MSE 的训练目标。

sentences.en: For the remaining $f$-divergences, we provide a min-max objective based on the variational formulation of the $f$-divergence.
sentences.zh: 对于其余的 $f$-散度，我们基于 $f$-散度的变分形式提供一个极小极大目标。

sentences.en: We theoretically analyze and numerically validate how different $f$-divergences impact the gradient magnitude and the convergence properties of the algorithm, affecting the quality of unlearning.
sentences.zh: 我们从理论上分析并从数值上验证了不同的 $f$-散度如何影响算法的梯度幅度和收敛性质，从而影响遗忘的质量。

sentences.en: For instance, we observe that the Hellinger closed-form instance consistently dominates MSE across multiple scenarios.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们观察到 Hellinger 闭式实例在多种场景中一致地优于 MSE。

sentences.en: More generally, the proposed unified framework offers a flexible paradigm for selecting the optimal divergence based on the application and user goal, allowing for finer control over the trade-off between unlearning efficacy and generative fidelity.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，所提出的统一框架提供了一种灵活的范式，可以根据应用和用户目标选择最优散度，从而能够更精细地控制遗忘效力与生成保真度之间的权衡。

title_en: A Unified Sparse Attention via Multi-Granularity Compression
title_zh: 通过多粒度压缩实现统一稀疏注意力

sentences.en: Efficient long-context understanding is increasingly vital for large language model (LLM) applications such as multi-turn dialogue and program analysis.
sentences.zh: 高效的长上下文理解对于大语言模型（LLM）应用（例如多轮对话和程序分析）日益重要。

sentences.en: However, the core self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length, creating a fundamental computational bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 然而，核心自注意力随序列长度二次增长，构成了一个根本性的计算瓶颈。

sentences.en: Existing sparse attention methods alleviate this issue but face trade-offs: training-based methods are costly and cannot be directly applied as acceleration plugins for other models, while inference-time methods often compromise efficiency or cross-modal generality.
sentences.zh: 现有的稀疏注意力方法缓解了这一问题，但面临权衡：基于训练的方法代价高昂，且无法直接作为其他模型的加速插件使用；而推断时方法往往在效率或跨模态通用性上有所妥协。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we present UniSparse, a unified mechanism that introduces the notion of composite tokens—compact representations that aggregate multi-granularity contextual information.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些局限，我们提出 UniSparse，一种统一机制，它引入复合 token（composite token）的概念——一种聚合多粒度上下文信息的紧凑表示。

sentences.en: Building on this abstraction, UniSparse dynamically constructs sparse attention through multi-granularity compression and block-level selection, enabling efficient and hardware-friendly execution on GPU.
sentences.zh: 基于这一抽象，UniSparse 通过多粒度压缩和块级选择动态地构建稀疏注意力，从而在 GPU 上实现高效且硬件友好的执行。

sentences.en: Across multiple modalities and tasks ranging from synthetic benchmarks to real-world applications, UniSparse consistently surpasses state-of-the-art sparse attention methods (e.g., MInference, XAttention, FlexPrefill) in both accuracy and efficiency, achieving $\ge$ 99\% of full-attention accuracy and up to 2.61$\times$ faster attention computation than FlashAttention.
sentences.zh: 横跨多种模态和从合成基准到真实世界应用的任务，UniSparse 在精度和效率两方面都一致地超越最先进的稀疏注意力方法（例如 MInference、XAttention、FlexPrefill），达到完整注意力精度的 $\ge$ 99\%，并且注意力计算比 FlashAttention 快达 2.61$\times$。

title_en: A unified theory of feature learning in RNNs and DNNs
title_zh: 循环神经网络与深度神经网络中特征学习的统一理论

sentences.en: Recurrent and deep neural networks (RNNs/DNNs) are cornerstone architectures in machine learning.
sentences.zh: 循环神经网络和深度神经网络（RNN/DNN）是机器学习中的基石架构。

sentences.en: Remarkably, RNNs differ from DNNs only by weight sharing, as can be shown through unrolling in time.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，由于可以在时间上展开（unrolling），RNN 与 DNN 的差别仅在于权重共享。

sentences.en: How does this structural similarity fit with the distinct functional properties these networks exhibit?
sentences.zh: 这种结构上的相似性如何与这些网络表现出的不同功能特性相吻合呢？

sentences.en: To address this question, we here develop a unified mean-field theory for RNNs and DNNs in terms of representational kernels, describing fully trained networks in the feature learning ($\mu$P) regime.
sentences.zh: 为了回答这一问题，我们在表示核框架下为 RNN 和 DNN 发展了一个统一的平均场理论，描述了特征学习（$\mu$P）机制中充分训练的网络。

sentences.en: This theory casts training as Bayesian inference over sequences and patterns, directly revealing the functional implications induced by the RNNs' weight sharing.
sentences.zh: 该理论将训练视为对序列和模式的贝叶斯推断，直接揭示了 RNN 权重共享所引发的功能含义。

sentences.en: In DNN-typical tasks, we identify a phase transition when the learning signal overcomes the noise due to randomness in the weights: below this threshold, RNNs and DNNs behave identically; above it, only RNNs develop correlated representations across timesteps.
sentences.zh: 在 DNN 典型任务中，我们识别出一个相变：当学习信号克服由权重随机性所引入的噪声时，该相变发生；低于此阈值时，RNN 和 DNN 表现相同；高于此阈值时，只有 RNN 会在时间步之间发展出相关的表示。

sentences.en: For sequential tasks, the RNNs' weight sharing furthermore induces an inductive bias that aids generalization by interpolating unobserved time steps.
sentences.zh: 对于序贯任务，RNN 的权重共享还引入了一种归纳偏置，通过插值未观测的时间步来帮助泛化。

sentences.en: Overall, our theory offers a way to connect architectural structure to functional biases.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的理论提供了一种将架构结构与功能偏置联系起来的途径。

title_en: A Unifying Relational Perspective on Expressive Lottery Tickets
title_zh: 从统一的关系视角理解高表达能力彩票子网络

sentences.en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are widely used, but how parameter sparsity affects the expressivity of relational (RGNNs) and temporal (TGNNs) variants is poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 图神经网络（GNN）被广泛使用，但参数稀疏性如何影响关系变体（RGNN）和时间变体（TGNN）的表达性，仍缺乏深入理解。

sentences.en: The Strong Expressive Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (SELTH) posits the existence of sparse GNNs that preserve Weisfeiler-Leman (WL) expressivity on static graphs.
sentences.zh: 强表达性彩票票据假设（SELTH）断言存在保持静态图上 Weisfeiler-Leman（WL）表达性的稀疏 GNN。

sentences.en: We generalize this existence result to a probabilistic statement for multi-relational and temporal domains via the relational WL (RWL).
sentences.zh: 我们通过关系 WL（RWL）将该存在性结果推广到多关系和时间领域的概率性陈述。

sentences.en: We prove that sufficiently parameterized RGNNs contain sparse subnetworks that maintain 1-RWL expressivity and derive a lower bound on the probability that a random pruning yields such a subnetwork.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，参数充分化的 RGNN 包含保持 1-RWL 表达性的稀疏子网络，并推导出随机剪枝产生此类子网络概率的一个下界。

sentences.en: We show that common TGNNs and cross-graph message passing schemes admit RGNN reformulations such that they inherit these guarantees and, moreover, that the expressivity of a sparse RGNN is connected to its optimization behavior under common update regimes.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，常见的 TGNN 和跨图消息传递方案允许 RGNN 重新表述，从而继承这些保证；此外，稀疏 RGNN 的表达性还与它在常见更新机制下的优化行为相关联。

sentences.en: Experiments instantiate the bound, compare it to empirical probabilities on synthetic data, and study how pre-training expressivity relates to optimization and prediction quality metrics on temporal and molecular benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 实验将该界实例化，将其与合成数据上的经验概率进行比较，并研究了预训练表达性与时间和分子基准上的优化及预测质量度量之间的关系。

authors.name: Franka Bause
authors.institution: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security

title_en: A Unifying View of Variational Generative Wasserstein Flows
title_zh: 变分生成 Wasserstein 流的统一视角

sentences.en: Many modern generative models can be viewed as minimizing divergences between probability distributions, yet they rely on different algorithmic and geometric principles.
sentences.zh: 许多现代生成模型可以看作是最小化概率分布之间的散度，但它们依赖于不同的算法和几何原理。

sentences.en: Wasserstein gradient flows provide a continuous-time formulation for optimizing over distributions, and can be approximated through their implicit discretization via the Jordan–Kinderlehrer–Otto (JKO) scheme.
sentences.zh: Wasserstein 梯度流提供了一种在分布上优化的连续时间形式，并可以通过 Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto（JKO）方案进行隐式离散化来近似。

sentences.en: In this work, we present a unified theoretical framework for generative modeling based on Wasserstein gradient flows, which we refer to as Generative Wasserstein Flows.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了一个基于 Wasserstein 梯度流的生成建模统一理论框架，称为生成式 Wasserstein 流（Generative Wasserstein Flows）。

sentences.en: We show that a broad class of existing methods can be derived as instances of parametric JKO schemes for f-divergences objectives, and we establish equivalences between several recently proposed algorithms.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，一大类现有方法可以推导为针对 f-散度目标的参数化 JKO 方案的实例，并且我们建立了若干近期算法之间的等价性。

sentences.en: We extend this framework beyond f-divergences to integral probability metrics, deriving new JKO-based generative algorithms for objectives such as Maximum Mean Discrepancy.
sentences.zh: 我们将该框架从 f-散度扩展到积分概率度量，为最大均值差异（Maximum Mean Discrepancy）等目标推导出新的基于 JKO 的生成算法。

sentences.en: We also clarify their connections with GANs.
sentences.zh: 我们还厘清了它们与 GAN 之间的联系。

sentences.en: Finally, we analyze parametric Wasserstein flows, where the evolution is restricted to distributions generated by parameterized maps.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们分析了参数化 Wasserstein 流，其中演化被限制在由参数化映射生成的分布上。

sentences.en: We characterize the resulting dynamics as projected or preconditioned Wasserstein gradient flows, highlighting the role of the Wasserstein geometry in shaping the learning dynamics of generative models.
sentences.zh: 我们将由此产生的动力学刻画为投影或预条件化的 Wasserstein 梯度流，凸显了 Wasserstein 几何在塑造生成模型学习动力学中的作用。

title_en: A Very Big Video Reasoning Suite
title_zh: 超大规模视频推理套件

sentences.en: Rapid progress in video models has largely focused on visual quality, leaving their reasoning capabilities underexplored.
sentences.zh: 视频模型的快速进展主要聚焦于视觉质量，而其推理能力仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: Video reasoning grounds intelligence in spatiotemporally consistent visual environments that go beyond what text can naturally capture, enabling intuitive reasoning over spatiotemporal structure, such as continuity, interaction, and causality.
sentences.zh: 视频推理将智能建立在时空一致的视觉环境之上，这种环境超越了文本所能自然捕捉的内容，使人们能够对连续性、交互和因果性等时空结构进行直观推理。

sentences.en: However, systematically studying video reasoning and its scaling behavior is hindered by the lack of large-scale video reasoning training data.
sentences.zh: 然而，对视频推理及其扩展行为进行系统性研究，受到缺乏大规模视频推理训练数据的阻碍。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce the **Very Big Video Reasoning (VBVR) Dataset**, an unprecedentedly large-scale resource spanning *200* curated reasoning tasks following a principled taxonomy, and over *one million* video clips, making it approximately *three orders of magnitude* larger than existing datasets.
sentences.zh: 为了弥补这一空白，我们引入**超大型视频推理（VBVR）数据集**，这是一个规模空前的资源，涵盖遵循原则性分类法的 *200* 项精选推理任务，以及超过 *一百万* 个视频片段，比现有数据集大约*高出三个数量级*。

sentences.en: We further present **VBVR-Bench**, a verifiable evaluation framework that moves beyond model-based judging by incorporating rule-based, human-aligned scorers, enabling reproducible and interpretable diagnosis of video reasoning capabilities.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出 **VBVR-Bench**，一个可验证的评估框架，它通过纳入基于规则、与人类对齐的评分器而超越基于模型的评判，从而能够对视频推理能力进行可复现、可解释的诊断。

sentences.en: Leveraging the VBVR suite, we conduct one of the first video reasoning **scaling studies** and observe early signs of emergent generalization to unseen reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 利用 VBVR 套件，我们进行了首批视频推理**扩展研究**之一，并观察到了对未见推理任务出现涌现式泛化的早期迹象。

sentences.en: Together, VBVR lays a foundation for the next stage of research in generalizable video reasoning.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，VBVR 为可泛化视频推理的下一阶段研究奠定了基础。

sentences.en: The data, benchmark tool kit, and models are released publicly at **video-reason.com**.
sentences.zh: 数据、基准工具包和模型已在 **video-reason.com** 公开发布。

title_en: A$^2$SG: Adaptive and Asymmetric Surrogate Gradients for Training Deep Spiking Neural Networks
title_zh: A$^2$SG：用于训练深度脉冲神经网络的自适应非对称替代梯度

sentences.en: Training deep spiking neural networks (SNNs) remains challenging due to sharp loss landscapes and temporal inconsistency caused by surrogate gradients.
sentences.zh: 由于替代梯度导致的尖锐损失景观和时间不一致性，训练深度脉冲神经网络（SNN）仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose a unified framework: adaptive and asymmetric surrogate gradients (A$^2$SG).
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些挑战，我们提出一个统一框架：自适应非对称替代梯度（A$^2$SG）。

sentences.en: The adaptive gradients adjust an effective window for spatio-temporal adaptation, reducing spatial gradient variation and maintaining directional consistency of gradients over time.
sentences.zh: 自适应梯度调整一个有效的窗口以进行时空自适应，减少空间梯度变化，并维持梯度随时间的方向一致性。

sentences.en: The asymmetric gradients reflect neuronal dynamics by assigning larger gradients to neurons with higher membrane potentials, and we prove that they yield lower variation than symmetric surrogates.
sentences.zh: 非对称梯度通过为具有更高膜电位的神经元分配更大的梯度来反映神经动力学，我们证明它们比对称替代产生更低的方差。

sentences.en: Our analysis further establishes a direct connection between local gradient variation and the curvature of the loss landscape, providing a principled explanation for how A$^2$SG promotes convergence to flatter minima and improves generalization.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析进一步建立了局部梯度变化与损失景观曲率之间的直接联系，为 A$^2$SG 如何促进收敛到更平坦的极小值并改善泛化提供了有原则的解释。

sentences.en: We conduct extensive experiments on diverse models, including CNN-based and Transformer-based SNNs, across various tasks such as image classification using both static and neuromorphic datasets, as well as segmentation.
sentences.zh: 我们在多样化的模型（包括基于 CNN 和基于 Transformer 的 SNN）上开展了大量实验，覆盖了使用静态和神经形态数据集的图像分类以及分割等各类任务。

sentences.en: The results demonstrate that A$^2$SG consistently improves accuracy and energy efficiency, establishing it as a general and reliable solution for training deep SNNs.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，A$^2$SG 一致地改善准确率和能量效率，使其成为训练深度 SNN 的一种通用且可靠的解决方案。

sentences.en: Our code is available at  https://github.com/KIST-NCL/A2SG.git.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/KIST-NCL/A2SG.git 获取。

title_en: A-MemGuard: A Proactive Defense Framework For LLM-Based Agent Memory
title_zh: A-MemGuard：基于大语言模型的智能体记忆主动防御框架

sentences.en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents use memory to learn from past interactions.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体利用记忆从过去的交互中学习。

sentences.en: However, this reliance on memory introduces a critical security risk: an adversary can inject seemingly harmless records into an agent's memory to manipulate its future behavior.
sentences.zh: 然而，对记忆的这种依赖引入了一个关键的安全风险：攻击者可以向智能体的记忆中注入看似无害的记录，以操纵其未来的行为。

sentences.en: This vulnerability is characterized by two core aspects: First, the malicious effect of injected records is only activated within a specific context, making them hard to detect when individual memory entries are audited in isolation.
sentences.zh: 这一漏洞由两个核心方面刻画：首先，注入记录的恶意效果只会在特定上下文中被激活，因此在孤立审计单个记忆条目时难以检测。

sentences.en: Second, once triggered, the manipulation can initiate a self-reinforcing error cycle: the corrupted outcome is stored as precedent, which not only amplifies the initial error but also progressively lowers the threshold for similar attacks in the future.
sentences.zh: 其次，一旦被触发，这种操纵就可能启动一个自我强化的错误循环：被破坏的结果作为先例被存储，这不但放大了初始错误，还逐步降低了未来类似攻击的门槛。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we introduce \emph{A-MemGuard} (\underline{A}gent-\underline{Mem}ory \underline{Guard}), the first defense framework for LLM agent memory.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些挑战，我们引入 A-MemGuard（Agent-Memory Guard，智能体-记忆-守卫），这是首个面向 LLM 智能体记忆的防御框架。

sentences.en: The core idea of our work is the insight that memory itself must become both \emph{self-checking} and \emph{self-correcting}.
sentences.zh: 我们工作的核心思想是这样一个洞见：记忆本身必须同时具备*自我检查*和*自我纠正*能力。

sentences.en: Without modifying the agent's core architecture, A-MemGuard combines two mechanisms: (1) \textbf{consensus-based validation}, which detects anomalies by comparing reasoning paths derived from multiple related memories and (2) a \textbf{dual-memory structure}, where detected failures are distilled into ``lessons'' stored separately and consulted before future actions, breaking error cycles and enabling adaptation.
sentences.zh: 在不修改智能体核心架构的情况下，A-MemGuard 结合了两种机制：（1）*基于共识的验证*，通过比较源自多个相关记忆的推理路径来检测异常；（2）*双记忆结构*，将检测到的失败蒸馏为“教训”并单独存储，在未来的行动之前进行查阅，从而打破错误循环并实现适应。

sentences.en: Comprehensive evaluations on multiple benchmarks show that A-MemGuard effectively cuts attack success rates by over 95\% while incurring a minimal utility cost.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上的全面评估表明，A-MemGuard 能够将攻击成功率有效降低超过 95\%，同时仅带来极小的效用损失。

sentences.en: This work shifts LLM memory security from static filtering to a proactive, experience-driven model where defenses strengthen over time.
sentences.zh: 这项工作将 LLM 记忆安全从静态过滤转变为一种主动的、经验驱动的模式，使防御能够随时间不断强化。

title_en: A3: an Analytical Low-Rank Approximation Framework for Attention
title_zh: A3：注意力的解析低秩近似框架

sentences.en: Large language models have demonstrated remarkable performance; however, their massive parameter counts make deployment highly expensive.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型展现了卓越的性能；然而，其庞大的参数量使部署成本极为高昂。

sentences.en: Low-rank approximation offers a promising compression solution, yet existing approaches have two main limitations: (1) They focus on minimizing the output error of individual linear layers, without considering the architectural characteristics of Transformers, and (2) they decompose a large weight matrix into two small low-rank matrices.
sentences.zh: 低秩近似提供了一种有前景的压缩方案，但现有方法有两个主要局限：（1）它们专注于最小化单个线性层的输出误差，而没有考虑 Transformer 的架构特性；（2）它们将一个大权重矩阵分解为两个小的低秩矩阵。

sentences.en: Consequently, these methods often fall short compared to other compression techniques like pruning and quantization, and introduce runtime overhead such as the extra GEMM kernel launches and memory operations for decomposed small matrices.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些方法相比于剪枝和量化等其他压缩技术往往有所不足，并且会引入运行时开销，例如额外 GEMM 内核启动以及分解后小矩阵的内存操作。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose $A^3$, a post-training low-rank approximation framework.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些局限，我们提出 $A^3$，一个训练后低秩近似框架。

sentences.en: $A^3$ splits a Transformer layer into three functional components, namely $\texttt{QK}$, $\texttt{OV}$, and $\texttt{MLP}$ and provides analytical solutions that reduces the hidden dimension size inside each component while minimizing the component's functional loss.
sentences.zh: $A^3$ 将 Transformer 层分割为三个功能组件，即 $\texttt{QK}$、$\texttt{OV}$ 和 $\texttt{MLP}$，并提供解析解，在最小化组件功能损失的同时减小每个组件内的隐藏维度大小。

sentences.en: This approach directly reduces model sizes, KV cache sizes, and FLOPs without introducing any runtime overheads.
sentences.zh: 这种方法直接减小模型大小、KV 缓存大小和 FLOPs，而不引入任何运行时开销。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments, we show that $A^3$ maintains superior performance compared to SoTAs.
sentences.zh: 通过大量实验，我们表明 $A^3$ 相比当前最优方法（SoTA）保持了优越的性能。

sentences.en: For example, under the same reduction budget in computation and memory, our low-rank approximated LLaMA 3.1-70B achieves a perplexity of 4.69 on WikiText-2, outperforming the previous SoTA's 7.87 by 3.18. We also show versatile applications of $A^3$ in KV cache compression, integration with quantization, fine-tuning and mixed-rank assignments.
sentences.zh: 例如，在相同的计算和内存压缩预算下，我们的低秩近似 LLaMA 3.1-70B 在 WikiText-2 上取得了 4.69 的困惑度，以 3.18 的优势超越了先前 SoTA 的 7.87。我们还展示了 $A^3$ 在 KV 缓存压缩、与量化集成、微调和混合秩分配方面的多种应用。

sentences.en: We open-sourced our framework at https://github.com/DeepWok/a3.
sentences.zh: 我们已将框架开源，地址为 https://github.com/DeepWok/a3。

title_en: AAD-1: Asymmetric Adversarial Distillation for One-Step Autoregressive Video Generation
title_zh: AAD-1：通过非对称对抗蒸馏实现单步自回归视频生成

sentences.en: We present \textbf{AAD-1}, an \textbf{A}symmetric \textbf{A}dversarial \textbf{D}istillation framework for \textbf{O}ne-step autoregressive image-to-video generation.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 AAD-1，一个用于一步式自回归图像到视频生成的**非对称对抗蒸馏**框架。

sentences.en: State-of-the-art methods adopt adversarial distillation but suffer from motion collapse and training instability, resulting in static videos.
sentences.zh: 最先进的方法采用对抗蒸馏，但会受到运动坍缩和训练不稳定的困扰，导致生成静态视频。

sentences.en: AAD-1 addresses these challenges through two key designs in architecture and training strategy.
sentences.zh: AAD-1 通过架构和训练策略方面的两个关键设计来解决这些挑战。

sentences.en: Our key architectural insight is to break the symmetry between generator and discriminator.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键架构洞见是打破生成器与判别器之间的对称性。

sentences.en: While the generator remains causal to preserve autoregressive sampling capability, the discriminator attends bidirectionally over the full spatiotemporal context and produces a single holistic realism score for the entire video sequence.
sentences.zh: 生成器保持因果性以保留自回归采样能力，而判别器在完整的时空上下文上进行双向注意力，并为整个视频序列产生一个整体的真实性评分。

sentences.en: This asymmetric design enables the discriminator to effectively detect global temporal failures and long-range drift that cause motion collapse in autoregressive generation.
sentences.zh: 这种非对称设计使判别器能够有效检测导致自回归生成中运动坍缩的全局时间失败和长程漂移。

sentences.en: To stabilize training, we introduce a phased strategy that first uses distribution matching to bootstrap a stable one-step generator, providing a warm-up phase that brings the student distribution closer to the teacher before adversarial distillation begins.
sentences.zh: 为了稳定训练，我们引入一个分阶段策略，首先使用分布匹配来引导出一个稳定的一步式生成器，提供一个预热阶段，在对抗蒸馏开始前让学生分布更接近教师分布。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on VBench demonstrate that AAD-1 achieves state-of-the-art performance in one-step autoregressive video generation.
sentences.zh: 在 VBench 上进行的大量实验表明，AAD-1 在一步式自回归视频生成中达到了当前最优性能。

title_en: ABC-Bench: An Agentic Bio-Capabilities Benchmark for Biosecurity
title_zh: ABC-Bench：面向生物安全的智能体生物学能力基准

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly acquiring capabilities relevant to biological research, from literature synthesis to interpretation of experimental data.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正在迅速获得与生物学研究相关的能力，从文献综合到实验数据的解读。

sentences.en: Increasingly, LLM agents can also perform *in silico* biology tasks that previously required experienced human biologists.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的 LLM 智能体还能够执行以往需要经验丰富的人类生物学家才能完成的*计算机内*（in silico）生物学任务。

sentences.en: These emerging AI capabilities offer new opportunities for scientific discovery and biomedical advances, but they also shift the landscape of biosecurity risks.
sentences.zh: 这些新兴的 AI 能力为科学发现和生物医学进展提供了新的机遇，但也改变了生物安全风险的格局。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce the Agentic Bio-Capabilities Benchmark (ABC-Bench), a suite of tasks to measure agentic biosecurity-relevant capabilities.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们引入智能体生物能力基准（ABC-Bench），一组用于衡量与生物安全相关智能体能力的任务套件。

sentences.en: ABC-Bench evaluates LLM agents on both benign and dual-use biology tasks: writing code to operate liquid handling robots, designing DNA fragments for in vitro assembly, and evading DNA synthesis screening.
sentences.zh: ABC-Bench 在良性和双重用途的生物学任务上评估 LLM 智能体：编写代码操作液体处理机器人、为体外组装设计 DNA 片段，以及规避 DNA 合成筛查。

sentences.en: These tasks require a combination of biology and software expertise.
sentences.zh: 这些任务需要生物学与软件专业知识的结合。

sentences.en: All tested LLM agents outperformed the median expert human baseliner on all three tasks.
sentences.zh: 所有受测的 LLM 智能体在这三个任务上都优于中位数的专家人类基线。

sentences.en: Agents performed highly on tasks drawing on published knowledge and well-documented protocols, and more weakly on a task requiring novel bioinformatics reasoning.
sentences.zh: 智能体在依赖已发表知识和记录完善的协议的任务上表现优异，而在需要新颖生物信息学推理的任务上表现较弱。

sentences.en: In three wet-lab validation experiments, we found that OpenAI’s o4-mini-high produced scripts that, when run on an OpenTrons liquid handling robot, successfully assembled DNA with expected sequences.
sentences.zh: 在三个湿实验室验证实验中，我们发现 OpenAI 的 o4-mini-high 生成的脚本在 OpenTrons 液体处理机器人上运行后，成功组装出了具有预期序列的 DNA。

title_en: ABCD: All Biases Come Disguised
title_zh: ABCD：所有偏见都披着伪装

sentences.en: Multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmarks have been a standard evaluation practice for measuring LLMs' ability to reason and answer knowledge-based questions.
sentences.zh: 多项选择（MCQ）基准一直是衡量 LLM 推理和回答知识型问题能力的标准评估实践。

sentences.en: Through a synthetic NonsenseQA benchmark, we observe that different LLMs exhibit varying degrees of label-position-few-shot-prompt bias, where the model either uses the answer position, the label in front of the answer, the distributions of correct answers present in the few-shot prompt, or a combination of all to answer each MCQ question.
sentences.zh: 通过一个合成的 NonsenseQA 基准，我们观察到不同 LLM 表现出不同程度的标签位置-少样本提示偏差，即模型要么使用答案位置、答案前面的标签、少样本提示中正确答案的分布，要么综合使用所有这些信息来回答每个 MCQ 问题。

sentences.en: We propose a simple bias-reduced evaluation protocol that replaces the labels of each question with uniform, unordered labels and prompts the LLM to use the whole answer presented.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个简单的降偏评估协议，将每个问题的标签替换为统一的、无序的标签，并提示 LLM 使用所呈现的完整答案。

sentences.en: With a simple sentence similarity model, we demonstrate improved robustness and lower standard deviation between different permutations of answers with a minimal drop in the LLM's performance, exposing the LLM's capabilities under reduced evaluation artifacts, without any help from the prompt examples or the option labels.
sentences.zh: 借助一个简单的句子相似度模型，我们证明了在 LLM 性能损失极小的前提下，不同答案排列之间的稳健性有所提高、标准差更低，从而在无需提示示例或选项标签任何帮助的情况下，展示了 LLM 在减少评估伪影后的能力。

sentences.en: Across multiple benchmarks and models, this protocol substantially improves the robustness to answer permutations, reducing mean accuracy variance $3\times$ with only a minimal decrease in the model's mean performance.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准和模型上，该协议显著提高了对答案排列的稳健性，将平均准确率方差降低了 $3\times$，而模型平均性能仅小幅下降。

sentences.en: Through ablation studies on various embedding models and similarity functions, we show that the method is more robust than the standard ones.
sentences.zh: 通过对各种嵌入模型和相似度函数的消融研究，我们表明该方法比标准方法更加稳健。

title_en: Abductive Reasoning with Probabilistic Commonsense
title_zh: 结合概率常识的溯因推理

sentences.en: Recent efforts to improve the reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) have focused on integrating formal logic solvers within neurosymbolic frameworks.
sentences.zh: 近期提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的努力，聚焦于在神经符号框架中集成形式逻辑求解器。

sentences.en: A key challenge is that formal solvers lack commonsense world knowledge, preventing them from making reasoning steps that humans find obvious.
sentences.zh: 一个关键挑战是，形式求解器缺乏常识世界知识，因而无法执行人类认为显而易见的推理步骤。

sentences.en: Prior methods address this by using LLMs to supply missing commonsense assumptions, but these approaches implicitly assume universal agreement on such commonsense facts.
sentences.zh: 先前的方法通过让 LLM 提供缺失的常识假设来解决这一问题，但这些方法隐式地假设人们对此类常识事实存在普遍共识。

sentences.en: In reality, commonsense beliefs vary across individuals.
sentences.zh: 在现实中，常识信念因人而异。

sentences.en: We propose a probabilistic framework for abductive commonsense reasoning that explicitly models this variation, aiming to determine whether most people would judge a statement as true or false.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个用于溯因常识推理的概率框架，显式地对这种差异进行建模，旨在判断大多数人会认为某个陈述为真还是为假。

sentences.en: We introduce Probabilistic Abductive CommonSense (PACS), a novel algorithm that uses an LLM and a formal solver to sample proofs as observations of individuals’ distinct commonsense beliefs, and aggregates conclusions across these samples.
sentences.zh: 我们引入概率溯因常识（PACS）这一新颖算法，它使用 LLM 和形式求解器将证明作为个体不同常识信念的观测进行采样，并在这些样本上聚合结论。

sentences.en: Empirically, PACS outperforms chain-of-thought reasoning, prior neurosymbolic methods, and search-based approaches across multiple benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 实证上，PACS 在多个基准上优于思维链推理、先前的神经符号方法和基于搜索的方法。

title_en: ABSINT-AI: Agentic Heap Abstractions for Abstract Interpretation
title_zh: ABSINT-AI：用于抽象解释的智能体式堆抽象

sentences.en: Static program analysis is a foundational technique in software engineering for reasoning about program behavior.
sentences.zh: 静态程序分析是软件工程中用于推理程序行为的基础技术。

sentences.en: Traditional static analysis algorithms model programs as logical systems with well-defined semantics, but rely on uniform, hard-coded heap abstractions.
sentences.zh: 传统的静态分析算法将程序建模为具有良好定义语义的逻辑系统，但依赖统一的、硬编码的堆抽象。

sentences.en: This limits their precision and flexibility, especially in dynamic languages like JavaScript, where heap structures are heterogeneous and difficult to analyze statically.
sentences.zh: 这限制了它们的精度和灵活性，尤其是在 JavaScript 等动态语言中，那里的堆结构是异构的，难以静态分析。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce ABSINT-AI, a language-model-guided static analysis framework that augments abstract interpretation with adaptive, per-object heap abstractions for Javascript.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入 ABSINT-AI，一个语言模型引导的静态分析框架，它为 JavaScript 的抽象解释补充了自适应的、逐对象的堆抽象。

sentences.en: This enables the analysis to leverage high-level cues, such as naming conventions and access patterns, without requiring brittle, hand-engineered heuristics.
sentences.zh: 这使得分析能够利用高层线索（如命名约定和访问模式），而无需脆弱的手工启发式规则。

sentences.en: Importantly, the LM agent operates within a bounded interface and never directly manipulates program state, preserving the soundness guarantees of abstract interpretation.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，LM 智能体在一个有界的接口内操作，从不直接操纵程序状态，从而保留抽象解释的可靠性保证。

sentences.en: To evaluate our approach, we focus on a soundness-critical task: determining whether object property accesses may result in undefined or null dereferences.
sentences.zh: 为了评估我们的方法，我们聚焦于一个对可靠性至关重要的任务：判断对象属性访问是否可能导致未定义或空指针解引用。

sentences.en: This task directly models a common requirement in compiler optimizations, where proving that an access is safe enables the removal of dynamic checks or simplifies code motion.
sentences.zh: 该任务直接对应编译器优化中的一个常见需求，即证明某次访问是安全的，从而可以移除动态检查或简化代码移动。

sentences.en: On this task, ABSINT-AI reduces false positives by up to 34% compared to traditional static analyses with fixed heap abstractions, while preserving formal guarantees.
sentences.zh: 在此任务上，与使用固定堆抽象的传统静态分析相比，ABSINT-AI 将误报率最多降低 34%，同时保留形式化保证。

sentences.en: Our ablations show that the LM’s ability to interact agentically with the analysis environment is crucial, outperforming non-agentic LM predictions by 25%.
sentences.zh: 我们的消融研究表明，LM 与分析环境进行智能体式交互的能力至关重要，其表现比非智能体的 LM 预测高出 25%。

title_en: Absorbing Quantization Error by Deformable Noise Scheduler for Diffusion Models
title_zh: 利用可变形噪声调度器吸收扩散模型中的量化误差

sentences.en: Diffusion models deliver state-of-the-art image quality but are expensive to deploy.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型提供了最先进的图像质量，但部署成本高昂。

sentences.en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) can shrink models and speed up inference, yet residual quantization errors distort the diffusion distribution (the timestep-wise marginal over $\boldsymbol{x}_t$), degrading sample quality.
sentences.zh: 训练后量化（PTQ）可以缩小模型并加速推断，然而残留的量化误差会扭曲扩散分布（$\boldsymbol{x}_t$ 的逐时间步边缘分布），从而降低样本质量。

sentences.en: We propose a distribution-preserving framework that absorbs quantization error into the generative process without changing architecture or adding steps.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个分布保持的框架，在不改变架构或增加步数的前提下，将量化误差吸收进生成过程。

sentences.en: Deformable Noise Scheduler (DNS) reinterprets quantization as a principled timestep shift, mapping the quantized prediction distribution $\boldsymbol{x}_t$ back onto the original diffusion distribution so that the target marginal is preserved.
sentences.zh: 可变形噪声调度器（DNS）将量化重新解释为一种有原则的时间步偏移，把量化后的预测分布 $\boldsymbol{x}_t$ 映射回原始扩散分布，从而保持目标边缘分布。

sentences.en: Unlike trajectory-preserving or noise-injection methods limited to stochastic samplers, our approach preserves the distribution under both stochastic and deterministic samplers and extends to flow-matching with Gaussian conditional paths.
sentences.zh: 与仅适用于随机采样器的轨迹保持或噪声注入方法不同，我们的方法在随机和确定性采样器下都能保持分布，并可扩展到带高斯条件路径的流匹配。

sentences.en: It is plug-and-play and complements existing PTQ schemes.
sentences.zh: 它是即插即用的，能与现有 PTQ 方案互补。

sentences.en: Empirically, our method consistently enhances generation quality across diverse backbones and existing PTQ baselines.
sentences.zh: 实证上，我们的方法在多样化的骨干网络和现有 PTQ 基线上一致地提升生成质量。

sentences.en: Notably, when further quantizing the FP16 LoRA branch of SVDQuant to enable fully integer inference, our approach effectively mitigates the performance drop, reducing FID from 27.16 to 26.22. Code is available at https://github.com/ZephyrYoung-eYuan/DNS_AQE
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，当进一步量化 SVDQuant 的 FP16 LoRA 分支以实现完全整数推断时，我们的方法有效缓解了性能下降，将 FID 从 27.16 降低到 26.22。代码可在 https://github.com/ZephyrYoung-eYuan/DNS_AQE 获取。

title_en: Abstraction Induces the Brain Alignment of Language and Speech Models
title_zh: 抽象促使语言与语音模型形成脑对齐

sentences.en: Research has repeatedly demonstrated that intermediate hidden states extracted from large language models and speech audio models predict measured brain response to natural language stimuli.
sentences.zh: 研究已反复表明，从大语言模型和语音音频模型中提取的中间隐藏状态，能够预测对自然语言刺激所测量的脑响应。

sentences.en: Yet, very little is known about the representation properties that enable this high prediction performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，关于究竟是哪些表示性质造就了这种高预测性能，人们所知甚少。

sentences.en: Why is it the intermediate layers, and not the output layers, that are most effective for this unique and highly general transfer task?
sentences.zh: 为什么对于这一独特且高度通用的迁移任务，中间层而非输出层最为有效？

sentences.en: We give evidence that the correspondence between speech and language models and the brain derives from shared meaning abstraction and not their next-word prediction properties.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了证据表明，语音和语言模型与大脑之间的对应关系源于共享的意义抽象，而非它们的下一个词预测性质。

sentences.en: In particular, models construct higher-order linguistic features in their middle layers, cued by a peak in the layerwise *intrinsic dimension*, a measure of feature complexity.
sentences.zh: 特别地，模型在中间层构建高阶的语言特征，其提示来自于按层计算的*内在维度*（特征复杂度的一种度量）的峰值。

sentences.en: We show that a layer's intrinsic dimension strongly predicts how well it explains fMRI and ECoG signals; that the relation between intrinsic dimension and brain predictivity arises over model pre-training; and finetuning models to better predict the brain causally increases both representations' intrinsic dimension and their semantic content.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，一层的内在维度能够强烈预测它在解释 fMRI 和 ECoG 信号方面的好坏；内在维度与脑预测性之间的关系是在模型预训练过程中出现的；而为了更好预测大脑而对模型进行微调，会在因果上提升表示的内在维度和语义内容。

sentences.en: Results suggest that semantic richness, high intrinsic dimension, and brain predictivity mirror each other, and that the key driver of model-brain similarity is *rich meaning abstraction* of the inputs, where language modeling is a task sufficiently complex (but perhaps not the only) to require it.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，语义丰富度、高内在维度和脑预测性相互映照，驱动模型-大脑相似性的关键因素是输入*丰富的意义抽象*，其中语言建模是一个足够复杂（但也许并非唯一）且需要这种抽象的任务。

title_en: AC-ODM: Actor–Critic Online Data Mixing for Sample-Efficient LLM Pretraining
title_zh: AC-ODM：用于样本高效大语言模型预训练的行动者–评论家在线数据混合

sentences.en: Optimizing pretraining data composition is pivotal for LLM generalization.
sentences.zh: 优化预训练数据的构成对于 LLM 的泛化至关重要。

sentences.en: While dynamic mixing outperforms static strategies by capturing evolving training dynamics, current methods fail to reconcile computational efficiency with sample efficiency and structural flexibility for diverse pipelines.
sentences.zh: 动态混合通过捕捉不断演化的训练动态而优于静态策略，但当前的方法无法在计算效率、样本效率和面向多样化流水线的结构灵活性之间取得协调。

sentences.en: We introduce \textbf{Actor--Critic Online Data Mixing (AC-ODM)}, which approaches data mixing from a reinforcement learning perspective with a parameterized policy that we theoretically prove to act as a dynamic linear surrogate maximizing the constructive interference of gradients.
sentences.zh: 我们引入**行动者-评论家在线数据混合（AC-ODM）**，它从强化学习的视角处理数据混合，采用参数化策略，我们理论上证明了该策略充当一个动态线性替代，最大化梯度的相长干涉。

sentences.en: To enhance practical flexibility, AC-ODM supports two operational modes: (i) a \textbf{proxy mode} for fixed, pre-prepared corpora, where a policy learned on a small model is transferred to a larger target; and (ii) a \textbf{non-proxy mode} for direct end-to-end training from scratch without priors.
sentences.zh: 为增强实用灵活性，AC-ODM 支持两种操作模式：（i）**代理模式**，用于固定的、预先准备好的语料库，在小模型上学到的策略被迁移到更大的目标模型；（ii）**非代理模式**，用于无需先验的从头端到端直接训练。

sentences.en: Empirically, AC-ODM significantly outperforms prior methods in convergence speed and downstream accuracy across various architectures.
sentences.zh: 实证上，AC-ODM 在多种架构上的收敛速度和下游准确率方面显著优于先前的方法。

sentences.en: On Pythia-1B, it reaches optimal validation perplexity using up to 66\% fewer training steps than competitive baselines, delivering a 27.5\% relative improvement in MMLU accuracy and a 2.23$\times$ higher pass@1 on HumanEval, all while incurring a virtually negligible ($~$0.4\%) per-step wall-clock increase and only 2\% additional memory overhead.
sentences.zh: 在 Pythia-1B 上，它使用比有竞争力的基线少最多 66\% 的训练步数就达到最优验证困惑度，在 MMLU 准确率上带来 27.5\% 的相对提升，并在 HumanEval 上获得 2.23$\times$ 更高的 pass@1，同时每步墙钟时间几乎可以忽略不计地增加（约 0.4\%），内存开销仅增加 2\%。

sentences.en: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/DANG-ai/AC-ODM}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/DANG-ai/AC-ODM 获取。

title_en: Accelerated and Stable Convergence with Anchored Generalized Optimistic Method
title_zh: 利用带锚定的广义乐观方法实现加速且稳定的收敛

sentences.en: We study first-order methods for solving monotone variational inequalities arising in min-max optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们研究求解极大极小优化中所出现单调变分不等式的一阶方法。

sentences.en: Classical approaches such as the extragradient method rely on two gradient queries per iteration, which limits their analysis and applicability in the online and stochastic settings.
sentences.zh: 外梯度法等经典方法每次迭代需要两次梯度查询，这限制了它们在在线和随机设置中的分析与应用。

sentences.en: We propose a family of Generalized Optimistic Methods with Anchoring (GOMA), which combine two-time-scale optimistic updates with an anchoring term inspired by Halpern iteration.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一族带锚定的广义乐观方法（GOMA），它将双时间尺度乐观更新与受 Halpern 迭代启发的锚定项相结合。

sentences.en: In the deterministic setting, GOMA achieves the optimal accelerated last-iterate rate $\mathcal{O}(1/k^2)$ on the squared gradient norm for monotone Lipschitz operators.
sentences.zh: 在确定性设置下，GOMA 在单调 Lipschitz 算子上的平方梯度范数方面实现了最优的加速末次迭代速率 $\mathcal{O}(1/k^2)$。

sentences.en: In the stochastic setting with unbounded variance, a simplified single-call variant of GOMA achieves a last-iterate convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{k})$ on the squared gradient norm.
sentences.zh: 在方差无界的随机设置下，GOMA 的一个简化单次调用变体在平方梯度范数上实现了 $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{k})$ 的末次迭代收敛速率。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first such guarantee for stochastic monotone Lipschitz VIs in the unconstrained setting without variance reduction or growing batches.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这是无约束设置下、无需方差缩减或增大批量的单调 Lipschitz 变分不等式的首个此类保证。

authors.name: Eduard Gorbunov
authors.institution: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

title_en: Accelerated Dual Method for Distributed Optimization: An Inexact-Gradient View of Local Updates
title_zh: 分布式优化的加速对偶方法：从非精确梯度视角理解局部更新

sentences.en: In distributed machine learning, efficiently training across multiple agents with heterogeneous data distributions remains a central challenge.
sentences.zh: 在分布式机器学习中，如何在具有异构数据分布的多个智能体之间高效训练仍是一个核心挑战。

sentences.en: We address the problem of stochastic, strongly convex distributed optimization by applying accelerated gradient ascent to the dual variables and multi-step stochastic gradient descent (SGD) to the primal variables in the Lagrangian formulation.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在对偶变量上应用加速梯度上升、在拉格朗日形式化的原始变量上应用多步随机梯度下降（SGD），来解决随机强凸分布式优化问题。

sentences.en: This approach naturally enables local computation, as the inner SGD loops require no inter-agent communication.
sentences.zh: 这种方法天然支持局部计算，因为内部 SGD 循环不需要智能体间的通信。

sentences.en: We prove that the method converges for any number of local updates, attaining the optimal communication complexity when local computation is sufficient.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于任意数量的局部更新，该方法都收敛，并且在局部计算充分时达到最优的通信复杂度。

sentences.en: Our analysis builds on an inexact accelerated gradient framework, where the partial gradient of the Lagrangian with respect to the dual variables is treated as an inexact gradient of the dual function.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析建立在一个非精确加速梯度框架之上，其中拉格朗日量关于对偶变量的偏梯度被视为对偶函数的非精确梯度。

sentences.en: A notable byproduct of this framework is an algorithm that achieves optimal reproducibility guarantees under biased gradient estimates.
sentences.zh: 该框架的一个值得注意的副产品是一种算法，它能在有偏梯度估计下实现最优的可复现性保证。
